summary: Chore: Updates the project name tag in the automated timesheet workflow from 'primeage.life' to 'unirms' so time entries are logged under the correct project.
Chore: Adds an automated 'project-manager' agent; a task-ledger file; and a git hook that flags unlogged commits — process tooling for tracking work; not a timesheet feature itself.
quality_notes: the hook script is defensive (handles missing jq; rebases; first run) but its ledger-matching relies on fragile exact-string grep of table formatting; and none of this new automation logic has any test coverage.
